form.label: Alert IQ - Intelligent SOC Monitoring
form.description: Security alert prioritization, authentication monitoring, brute-force detection and false-positive reduction.

search.query: index=alert_iq sourcetype="alertiq:auth" | stats count AS total_events
index=alert_iq sourcetype="alertiq:auth" result="failure" | stats count AS failed_logins
index=alert_iq sourcetype="alertiq:auth" result="success" | stats count AS successful_logins

index=alert_iq sourcetype="alertiq:auth" result="failure" | bin _time span=5m | stats count AS failures BY _time src_ip user | where failures>=5 | eval severity="High" | table _time src_ip user failures severity

index=alert_iq sourcetype="alertiq:auth" | stats count(eval(result="failure")) AS failures count(eval(result="success")) AS successes BY src_ip user | where failures>=3 AND successes>0 | table src_ip user failures successes

index=alert_iq sourcetype="alertiq:auth" | stats count(eval(result="failure")) AS failures count(eval(result="success")) AS successes BY src_ip | eval risk_score=case( failures>=8,50, failures>=5,35, failures>=3,20, true(),0 ) | eval risk_score=risk_score+ if(failures>=3 AND successes>0,25,0) | eval severity=case( risk_score>=70,"Critical", risk_score>=50,"High", risk_score>=25,"Medium", true(),"Low" ) | table src_ip failures successes risk_score severity | sort -risk_score

index=alert_iq sourcetype="alertiq:auth" | lookup benign_ips src_ip OUTPUT reason expires | eval expiry_epoch=strptime(expires,"%Y-%m-%d") | eval classification=if( isnotnull(reason) AND expiry_epoch>=now(), "Known Benign", "Requires Investigation" ) | stats count BY classification
index=alert_iq sourcetype="alertiq:auth" | timechart span=1m count BY result
index=alert_iq sourcetype="alertiq:auth" result="failure" | stats count AS failures BY src_ip | sort -failures | head 10
